architecture_assumptions.arrival_process: deterministic periodic chunks with seeded +/-1% jitter
architecture_assumptions.boundary_semantics: rho is useful output bytes divided by raw input bytes
architecture_assumptions.prefetch_semantics: prefetch-only raises modeled DRAM service capacity by 20%; boundary bytes unchanged
architecture_assumptions.strangler_semantics: IPU consumes raw chunks, then emits rho-sized chunks across the host boundary
architecture_assumptions.topology: single FIFO server per ingress, boundary, DRAM, and compute stage
architecture_assumptions.units: decimal GB/s, MB=1e6 bytes, latency in microseconds

limitations: Synthetic rates and capacities are assumptions, not hardware measurements.
Each stage is modeled as one FIFO server; contention, coherence, and silicon effects are omitted.
Traffic reduction is boundary bytes only and must not be generalized to whole-model speedup.

provenance.model: deterministic FIFO fluid queue; no hardware measurements
